data.title: Accident questionnaire from Beispiel Versicherung
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG (motor claims service) wrote on 6 May 2026 about the traffic accident of 28 April 2026. The other party has made claims, and you must return the completed questionnaire within 10 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The other party in the accident has made claims against your liability insurer. To clarify who is at fault, the insurer needs your account of what happened. Fill in the questionnaire (Fragebogen zum Unfallhergang) and send it back by the deadline shown. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays. If you don't reply, the insurer may have to decide on fault without your account. Consider getting advice if you are unsure how to describe the accident. No questionnaire was included in the text provided, so check that it was enclosed.
